Codified traditional knowledge; cultivated medicinal plants, వాటి products; specified local people, communities; growers, cultivators; sustenance, livelihood కోసం indigenous medicine practice చేసే vaids, hakims, registered AYUSH practitioners వీటి పరిధిలోకి వస్తారు. కానీ every AYUSH enterprise, wild biological resources use లేదా foreign-linked personకు blanket exemption లేదు. వేరుగా, amended section 6లో relevant IP trigger application filing నుంచి right grant దశకు మారింది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Under substituted section 6, the decisive stage is grant of the IP right rather than filing of the application. This change in timing applies to both Indian and foreign applicants. Their legal routes still differ, because each category must fulfil a different obligation at or before that stage.
body.te: Substituted section 6 ప్రకారం decisive stage IP application filing కాదు; IP right grant. ఈ timing change Indian, foreign applicants ఇద్దరికీ వర్తిస్తుంది. అయినప్పటికీ వారి legal routes వేరు, ఎందుకంటే ఆ stageలో లేదా దానికి ముందు ప్రతి category fulfil చేయాల్సిన obligation వేరుగా ఉంటుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: A foreign-linked person or entity falling under section 3(2) must secure prior approval from the NBA before the IP right is granted. The 2023 Amendment shifted the trigger from application filing to grant, but it did not replace prior approval with simple registration for this category.
body.te: Section 3(2) పరిధిలోకి వచ్చే foreign-linked person లేదా entity, IP right grantకు ముందు NBA prior approval తప్పనిసరిగా పొందాలి. 2023 Amendment triggerను application filing నుంచి grantకు మార్చింది. కానీ ఈ categoryకి prior approval స్థానంలో simple registrationను పెట్టలేదు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: A section 7 Indian person must complete two distinct steps. Section 6(1A) requires registration with the NBA before the IP right is granted, and section 6(1B) requires NBA prior approval when that right is commercialised. Approval has therefore been deferred to commercialisation, not removed altogether.
body.te: Section 7 పరిధిలోని Indian person రెండు separate steps complete చేయాలి. Section 6(1A) ప్రకారం IP right grantకు ముందు NBAతో registration చేయాలి. Section 6(1B) ప్రకారం ఆ rightను commercialise చేసే సమయంలో NBA prior approval పొందాలి. అందువల్ల approval remove కాలేదు; commercialisation stageకు defer అయింది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The Amendment replaced the expression 'by-products' with the defined term 'derivative'. A derivative is a naturally occurring biochemical compound produced through the genetic expression or metabolism of biological or genetic resources, whether or not it contains functional units of heredity. This language more closely follows Nagoya Protocol terminology, but the Act and applicable rules must still be applied to decide whether a particular material falls within ABS.
body.te: Amendment, ‘by-products’ అనే expression స్థానంలో defined term ‘derivative’ను ఉపయోగించింది. Biological లేదా genetic resourcesలో genetic expression లేదా metabolism వల్ల naturally ఏర్పడే biochemical compoundను derivative అంటారు. అందులో functional units of heredity ఉన్నా లేకపోయినా definition వర్తించవచ్చు. ఈ language Nagoya Protocol terminologyకి మరింత దగ్గరగా ఉంది. అయితే particular materialకు ABS వర్తిస్తుందా అనే నిర్ణయం Act, applicable Rules ఆధారంగానే తీసుకోవాలి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The Government describes the 2023 changes as a way to remove unnecessary compliance obstacles affecting research, patenting and AYUSH activity based on Indian biological resources. It points to the later increase in related patent applications as evidence that participation became easier. This is the Government's assessment of policy impact, not a proposition stated in the statutory text.
body.te: Government వివరణ ప్రకారం 2023 changes, Indian biological resources ఆధారంగా జరిగే research, patenting, AYUSH activityలో unnecessary compliance obstaclesను తగ్గించాయి. తరువాత related patent applications పెరగడాన్ని participation సులభమైందనే evidenceగా Government చూపుతోంది. ఇది statutory textలో ఉన్న proposition కాదు; policy impactపై Government assessment.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Critics draw attention to another possible effect. Under the amended arrangement, the NBA has a larger role in negotiating ABS on behalf of local communities, instead of the communities directly helping to settle every benefit-sharing term. Their concern is that simpler compliance may weaken part of the Act's objective of empowering communities.
body.te: Critics మరో possible effectను గుర్తిస్తున్నారు. ప్రతి benefit-sharing termను settle చేయడంలో local communities directగా పాల్గొనడం బదులు, వారి behalfపై ABS negotiate చేసే NBA role amended arrangementలో పెరిగింది. Compliance సులభమైనా, communitiesను empower చేయాలనే Act objectiveలో ఒక భాగం weaken కావచ్చనేది వారి concern.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Supporters and critics are evaluating the same amendment from different policy perspectives. Supporters stress easier compliance, whereas critics stress the possible loss of direct community participation. Neither assessment is the wording of the statute itself. The AYUSH-related exclusion introduced by the amendment remains limited and conditional.
body.te: Supporters, critics ఒకే Amendmentను different policy perspectives నుంచి evaluate చేస్తున్నారు. Supporters easier complianceను emphasise చేస్తే, critics direct community participation తగ్గే possibilityని emphasise చేస్తున్నారు. ఈ రెండు assessmentsలో ఏదీ statute wording కాదు. Amendment తీసుకొచ్చిన AYUSH-related exclusion limitedగా, conditionsతోనే ఉంటుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The AYUSH-related exemption is confined to cultivated medicinal plants and their products where the knowledge used has already been codified in the prescribed authoritative texts. It does not extend to commercial bioprospecting involving wild-harvested resources, cancel the ABS obligations of foreign entities, or remove the NBA from the regulatory system.
body.te: AYUSH-related exemption, prescribed authoritative textsలో ఇప్పటికే codify అయిన knowledge ఆధారంగా ఉపయోగించే cultivated medicinal plants, వాటి productsకే పరిమితం. Wild-harvested resourcesతో జరిగే commercial bioprospectingకు ఇది వర్తించదు. Foreign entities ABS obligationsను cancel చేయదు; regulatory systemలో NBA roleను కూడా remove చేయదు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The 2023 Amendment did not end benefit sharing. It created only limited, conditional exclusions, while the wider ABS framework continued. That framework includes National, State and Local Biodiversity Funds, each with legally specified receipts and permitted uses.
body.te: 2023 Amendment benefit sharingను end చేయలేదు. Limited, conditional exclusions మాత్రమే ఇచ్చింది; wider ABS framework కొనసాగుతోంది. ఇందులో National, State, Local Biodiversity Funds ఉంటాయి. ప్రతి Fundలో ఏ receipts చేరాలి, వాటిని ఏ purposesకు use చేయాలి అనేది law చెబుతుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The three Biodiversity Funds correspond to the national, state and local levels, but three questions must be answered separately for each fund: which section creates it, which receipts enter it, and what expenditure the Act permits.
body.te: Three Biodiversity Funds national, State, local levelsకు correspond అవుతాయి. ప్రతి Fund గురించి మూడు questionsను separateగా చూడాలి: ఏ section దాన్ని create చేసింది? ఏ receipts అందులో చేరతాయి? Act ఏ expenditureను permit చేస్తుంది?

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Section 27 creates the National Biodiversity Fund. It receives section 26 grants and loans, NBA charges and benefit-sharing amounts, and other Central Government-specified sums. It may pay benefit claimers and support conservation, source-area development and locally consulted socio-economic development.
body.te: Section 27 National Biodiversity Fundను create చేస్తుంది. Section 26 grants and loans, NBA collect చేసే charges, benefit-sharing amounts, Central Government specify చేసే other sums ఇందులో చేరతాయి. Benefit claimersకు payment, conservation, source-area development, local bodiesతో consultation ద్వారా socio-economic developmentకు దీనిని use చేయవచ్చు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Section 32 establishes the State Biodiversity Fund. Its receipts include State grants and loans, NBA allocations and SBB charges or benefit-sharing amounts. It supports conservation, sustainable use, source-area development, BHS management, and compensation or rehabilitation of people economically affected by a BHS notification.
body.te: Section 32 State Biodiversity Fundను establish చేస్తుంది. State grants and loans, NBA allocations, SBB charges లేదా benefit-sharing amounts ఇందులో చేరతాయి. Conservation, sustainable use, source-area development, BHS management, అలాగే BHS notification వల్ల economically affected peopleకు compensation లేదా rehabilitation కోసం Fundను use చేయవచ్చు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Section 43 creates the Local Biodiversity Fund, and section 44 governs its use. Government or biodiversity-authority grants and loans, section 41(3) BMC access fees and benefit-sharing receipts enter it. Spending must serve biodiversity and the local community within that local body’s jurisdiction.
body.te: Section 43 Local Biodiversity Fundను create చేస్తుంది; section 44 దాని useను govern చేస్తుంది. Government లేదా biodiversity-authority grants and loans, section 41(3) BMC access fees, benefit-sharing receipts ఇందులో చేరతాయి. Spending ఆ local body jurisdictionలో biodiversity, local community benefitకే ఉండాలి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: These Funds show that the BDA controls access and also creates channels for sharing benefits. ABS receipts can move lawfully through national, state and local funds and reach eligible benefit claimers.
body.te: ఈ Funds వల్ల BDA accessను control చేయడమే కాక benefitsను share చేసే channelsను కూడా create చేస్తుంది. ABS receipts national, State, local Funds ద్వారా legally flow అయి eligible benefit claimersకు చేరవచ్చు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Permitted expenditure becomes progressively more local. The National Fund channels benefits and supports source areas; the State Fund additionally supports BHS management and affected people; the Local Fund is confined to biodiversity and community benefit within its own jurisdiction.
body.te: National నుంచి local levelకు వచ్చేకొద్దీ permitted expenditure మరింత local-specific అవుతుంది. National Fund benefits, source areasకు support ఇస్తుంది. State Fund BHS management, affected peopleను కూడా cover చేస్తుంది. Local Fund తన jurisdictionలో biodiversity, community benefitకే limited.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: This pattern reflects subsidiarity: where suitable, decisions and money should be handled close to the resource and community. The same principle connects NBA, SBB and BMC functions, but it creates coordination rather than an administrative command chain.
body.te: ఈ pattern subsidiarity principleను చూపుతుంది: suitableగా ఉన్నప్పుడు decisions, moneyను resource, communityకు close levelలో handle చేయాలి. ఇదే principle NBA, SBB, BMC functionsను connect చేస్తుంది; కానీ administrative command chainను create చేయదు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Three dates must be separated for the Biological Diversity Rules, 2024: signature on 22 October, Gazette publication on 25 October, and commencement on 24 December 2024 after sixty days. A separate procedural amendment followed on 6 May 2025.
body.te: Biological Diversity Rules, 2024కు three datesను mix చేయకూడదు: 22 October signature; 25 October Gazette publication; sixty days తరువాత 24 December 2024 commencement. Separate procedural amendment 6 May 2025న వచ్చింది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The Biological Diversity Amendment Rules were separately notified on 6 May 2025. This date is not the signature, publication or commencement date of the principal 2024 Rules. The official Gazette distinguishes the instruments and their G.S.R. notifications.
body.te: Biological Diversity Amendment Rulesను separateగా 6 May 2025న notify చేశారు. ఈ date principal 2024 Rules signature, publication లేదా commencement date కాదు. Official Gazette instrumentsను, వాటి G.S.R. notificationsను clearly separate చేస్తుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: MoEFCC made the principal Rules under BDA section 62 through G.S.R. 665(E). The instrument was signed on 22 October 2024, but signing alone did not determine commencement because the Rules linked operation to Gazette notification.
body.te: BDA section 62 powerతో MoEFCC principal Rulesను G.S.R. 665(E)గా చేసింది. Instrument 22 October 2024న sign అయింది. కానీ Rules operationను Gazette notificationతో link చేసినందున signature alone commencementను determine చేయదు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The controlling Gazette is the Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II, section 3(i), No. 607, with masthead date 25 October 2024 and ID CG-DL-E-25102024-258244. Thus 25 October is the publication date, not 22 October.
body.te: Controlling Gazette, Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II, section 3(i), No. 607. Masthead date 25 October 2024; ID CG-DL-E-25102024-258244. కాబట్టి publication date 25 October; 22 October కాదు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Rule 1(2) provides commencement sixty days after Official Gazette notification. Counting from the 25 October 2024 publication gives 24 December 2024 as the commencement date; 22 October remains only the signature date.
body.te: Rule 1(2) ప్రకారం Official Gazette notification తరువాత sixty daysకు Rules commence అవుతాయి. 25 October 2024 publication నుంచి count చేస్తే commencement 24 December 2024. 22 October signature date మాత్రమే.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The apparent three-day discrepancy arises when the 22 October signature date is mistaken for the 25 October publication date. Because the sixty-day period runs from Gazette notification, using the wrong starting date produces the wrong commencement date.
body.te: 22 October signature dateను 25 October publication dateగా treat చేస్తే three-day discrepancy వస్తుంది. Sixty-day period Gazette notification నుంచి run అవుతుంది; wrong starting date తీసుకుంటే commencement date కూడా wrong అవుతుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: A rule may be signed and Gazette-published on different dates. When its commencement clause refers to Gazette notification, publication controls the calculation. The BDA and 2023 Amendment provide the statutory framework; the 2024 Rules provide the detailed process from their commencement.
body.te: Rule signature, Gazette publication different datesలో ఉండవచ్చు. Commencement clause Gazette notificationను refer చేస్తే calculationకు publication dateనే control చేస్తుంది. BDA, 2023 Amendment statutory frameworkను ఇస్తాయి; 2024 Rules commencement నుంచి detailed processను ఇస్తాయి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: At national level, the Chennai-based NBA handles section 3(2) access, benefit sharing and other statutory functions. The SBB advises the State Government and handles section 7 prior intimations under sections 23–24. Locally, the BMC prepares and maintains the People’s Biodiversity Register under section 41 and the Rules.
body.te: National levelలో Chennai-based NBA section 3(2) access, benefit sharing, other statutory functionsను handle చేస్తుంది. SBB State Governmentకు advice ఇచ్చి, sections 23–24 కింద section 7 prior intimationsను deal చేస్తుంది. Local levelలో BMC section 41, Rules ప్రకారం People’s Biodiversity Registerను prepare, maintain చేస్తుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Do not combine two separate reforms. From 1 April 2024, the 2023 Amendment replaced the relevant BDA imprisonment provisions with monetary adjudication. Amended section 6 also requires a section 3(2) applicant to obtain NBA approval before IP grant rather than before application filing.
body.te: Two reformsను combine చేయకూడదు. 1 April 2024 నుంచి 2023 Amendment relevant BDA imprisonment provisions స్థానంలో monetary adjudicationను పెట్టింది. Amended section 6 ప్రకారం section 3(2) applicant, IP application filingకు ముందు కాకుండా IP grantకు ముందు NBA approval పొందాలి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: A section 7 Indian applicant follows two distinct IP steps: NBA registration before grant under section 6(1A), and NBA prior approval at commercialisation under section 6(1B). Separately, the Amendment provides only specified exclusions connected with cultivated medicinal plants and codified knowledge.
body.te: Section 7 Indian applicant two IP steps follow చేయాలి: section 6(1A) కింద grantకు ముందు NBA registration; section 6(1B) కింద commercialisation సమయంలో NBA prior approval. దీనికి separateగా cultivated medicinal plants, codified knowledgeకు specified exclusions ఉన్నాయి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The Act creates National, State and Local Biodiversity Funds. The National Fund channels benefits and supports source areas; the State Fund also covers BHS management and affected people; the Local Fund uses receipts, including BMC fees, for biodiversity within its jurisdiction. Purpose becomes more local at each lower level.
body.te: Act National, State, Local Biodiversity Fundsను create చేస్తుంది. National Fund benefitsను channel చేసి source areasకు support ఇస్తుంది. State Fund BHS management, affected peopleను కూడా cover చేస్తుంది. Local Fund BMC feesతో సహా receiptsను తన jurisdiction biodiversity కోసం use చేస్తుంది. Lower levelకు వెళ్లేకొద్దీ purpose మరింత local అవుతుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The BDA framework consists of the NBA, SBBs and local BMCs that maintain PBRs. The 2023 Amendment introduced monetary penalties and limited exclusions. Section 7 applicants register before IP grant and seek approval at commercialisation; section 3(2) applicants need approval before grant. The 2024 Rules were notified as G.S.R. 665(E).
body.te: BDA frameworkలో NBA, SBBs, PBRలను maintain చేసే local BMCs ఉన్నాయి. 2023 Amendment monetary penalties, limited exclusionsను తీసుకొచ్చింది. Section 7 applicants IP grantకు ముందు register చేసి commercialisationలో approval పొందాలి; section 3(2) applicants grantకు ముందు approval పొందాలి. 2024 Rules G.S.R. 665(E)గా notify అయ్యాయి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: G.S.R. 665(E), made under BDA section 62, was signed on 22 October 2024 and published on 25 October in Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II, section 3(i), No. 607. The publication date controls commencement.
body.te: BDA section 62 కింద చేసిన G.S.R. 665(E) 22 October 2024న sign అయి, 25 Octoberన Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II, section 3(i), No. 607లో publish అయింది. Commencementకు publication dateనే controlling date.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Rule 1(2) brought the Rules into force sixty days after Gazette notification. Publication on 25 October therefore yields 24 December 2024 as commencement. A separate minor amendment was issued on 6 May 2025.
body.te: Rule 1(2) ప్రకారం Gazette notification తరువాత sixty daysకు Rules అమల్లోకి వచ్చాయి. 25 October publication ఆధారంగా commencement 24 December 2024. Separate minor amendment 6 May 2025న issue అయింది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Under amended section 37, the State Government may notify a BHS only on an SBB recommendation. Before recommending, the SBB must consult both the relevant local body and BMC. Consultation, recommendation and notification therefore belong to different actors.
body.te: Amended section 37 ప్రకారం SBB recommendationపై మాత్రమే State Government BHSను notify చేయగలదు. Recommendationకు ముందు SBB relevant local body, BMC రెండింటితో consult చేయాలి. Consultation, recommendation, notification మూడు వేర్వేరు actorsకు చెందిన functions.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: After the amendment, an SBB recommendation and prior consultation with both the local body and BMC are statutory steps; only the State Government notifies. The September 2026 NBA dashboard figure of 57 BHSs is a dated snapshot, while 44 and the January 2024 WII–ENVIS figure of 54 are older snapshots. A BMC is not subordinate to an SBB.
body.te: Amendment తరువాత SBB recommendation, local bodyతో పాటు BMC consultation statutory steps; State Government మాత్రమే notify చేస్తుంది. September 2026 NBA dashboardలో 57 BHSs అనేది dated snapshot; 44, January 2024 WII–ENVIS 54 older snapshots. BMC, SBBకు subordinate కాదు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Different authorities constitute the three bodies. The Central Government establishes the NBA under section 8, the State Government establishes the SBB under section 22, and the relevant rural or urban local body constitutes the BMC under section 41(1).
body.te: Three bodiesను different authorities constitute చేస్తాయి. Section 8 కింద Central Government NBAను, section 22 కింద State Government SBBను, section 41(1) కింద relevant rural లేదా urban local body BMCని constitute చేస్తుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The institutional pyramid represents coordination and reporting, not command. The September 2026 NBA dashboard listed 2,76,664 BMCs and 2,72,648 PBRs, making this the largest Indian conservation-governance network by institutional count. The totals indicate reach, not the quality of every register.
body.te: Institutional pyramid coordination, reportingను చూపుతుంది; commandను కాదు. September 2026 NBA dashboardలో 2,76,664 BMCs, 2,72,648 PBRs ఉన్నాయి. Institutional count ప్రకారం ఇది Indiaలో largest conservation-governance network. Totals reachను చూపుతాయి; every register qualityని కాదు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Turmeric wound-healing, neem pesticidal and basmati name or trait claims became major biopiracy disputes before India had a domestic ABS law. India challenged them through legal and diplomatic routes. India ratified the CBD in 1994 and enacted the BDA in 2002; the 1990s disputes increased the political urgency for legislation.
body.te: Turmeric wound-healing, neem pesticidal, basmati name లేదా trait claims domestic ABS lawకు ముందు major biopiracy disputes అయ్యాయి. India వాటిని legal, diplomatic routesలో challenge చేసింది. India 1994లో CBD ratify చేసి, 2002లో BDA enact చేసింది; 1990s disputes legislation urgencyని పెంచాయి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Benefit sharing was not abolished by the 2023 Amendment. It introduced only specified exclusions associated with cultivated medicinal plants, codified traditional knowledge and eligible actors. Foreign-linked ABS duties and the NBA’s broader statutory role continue.
body.te: 2023 Amendment benefit sharingను abolish చేయలేదు. Cultivated medicinal plants, codified traditional knowledge, eligible actorsకు సంబంధించిన specified exclusions మాత్రమే ఇచ్చింది. Foreign-linked ABS duties, NBA broader statutory role కొనసాగుతాయి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The move from IP filing to grant was not confined to Indian applicants. Substituted section 6 uses grant as the relevant stage for both Indian and foreign-linked applicants; the difference lies in whether registration or prior approval is required and when commercialisation approval applies.
body.te: IP filing నుంచి grantకు shift Indian applicantsకే limited కాదు. Substituted section 6లో Indian, foreign-linked applicants ఇద్దరికీ grant relevant stage. Difference registrationనా, prior approvalనా, commercialisation approval ఎప్పుడు అవసరమా అన్న obligationలో ఉంటుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: Section 3(2) applicants require NBA prior approval before grant under section 6(1). Section 7 Indian applicants register before grant under section 6(1A) and obtain prior approval at commercialisation under section 6(1B). This second step means the Indian route is not approval-free.
body.te: Section 3(2) applicants section 6(1) కింద grantకు ముందు NBA prior approval పొందాలి. Section 7 Indian applicants section 6(1A) కింద grantకు ముందు register చేసి, section 6(1B) కింద commercialisationలో prior approval పొందాలి. ఈ second step వల్ల Indian route approval-free కాదు.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: An Indian section 7 applicant is not wholly exempt from NBA approval. Section 6(1A) requires registration before grant, while section 6(1B) still requires prior approval when the resulting IP right is commercialised.
body.te: Indian section 7 applicantకు NBA approval నుంచి complete exemption లేదు. Section 6(1A) grantకు ముందు registration కోరుతుంది; resulting IP right commercialise చేసే సమయంలో section 6(1B) prior approval ఇంకా అవసరం.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: For section 7 applicants, section 6(1B) postpones approval to commercialisation; it does not remove it. Do not confuse this IP rule with BHS procedure: under section 37 the SBB recommends after consultation, and only the State Government notifies.
body.te: Section 7 applicantsకు section 6(1B) approvalను commercialisation వరకు postpone చేస్తుంది; remove చేయదు. ఈ IP ruleను BHS procedureతో mix చేయకూడదు. Section 37 కింద consultation తరువాత SBB recommend చేస్తుంది; State Government మాత్రమే notify చేస్తుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The State Government cannot bypass amended section 37(1). The SBB must first consult the relevant local body and BMC and then recommend the site; only afterwards may the State Government notify it. The legal order is consultation, recommendation, notification.
body.te: State Government amended section 37(1)ను bypass చేయలేదు. SBB ముందుగా relevant local body, BMCతో consult చేసి siteను recommend చేయాలి; తరువాత మాత్రమే State Government notify చేయగలదు. Legal order: consultation, recommendation, notification.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: The claim that a BMC has no formal section 37 role relies on the old provision. The substituted section expressly requires consultation with both the local body and BMC before an SBB recommends a BHS. Omitting BMC consultation now omits a statutory step.
body.te: BMCకు section 37లో formal role లేదనే claim old provisionపై ఆధారపడింది. Substituted section ప్రకారం SBB BHS recommend చేయడానికి ముందు local body, BMC రెండింటితో expressly consult చేయాలి. BMC consultation omit చేస్తే statutory step miss అవుతుంది.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: BMCs are not village field units of an SBB. Section 8 assigns NBA establishment to the Central Government, section 22 assigns SBB establishment to the State Government, and section 41(1) assigns BMC constitution to the local body.
body.te: BMCs, SBB village field units కావు. Section 8 NBA establishmentను Central Governmentకు, section 22 SBB establishmentను State Governmentకు, section 41(1) BMC constitutionను local bodyకి assign చేస్తాయి.

title.en: Biological Diversity Act and local institutions
title.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య చట్టం మరియు స్థానిక సంస్థలు

body.en: A BMC is locally constituted and is not subordinate to an SBB; the three levels coordinate without forming a command chain. The Act also creates National, State and Local Biodiversity Funds. Charges, royalties and benefit-sharing receipts enter the relevant funds and finance legally assigned purposes so benefits can reach eligible claimers.
body.te: BMC localగా constitute అవుతుంది; SBBకు subordinate కాదు. Three levels command chainగా కాక coordinationతో పనిచేస్తాయి. Act National, State, Local Biodiversity Fundsను కూడా create చేస్తుంది. Charges, royalties, benefit-sharing receipts relevant Fundsలో చేరి legally assigned purposesకు finance ఇస్తాయి; benefits eligible claimersకు చేరేలా చేస్తాయి.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: The Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980 was renamed the Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980 in 2023. Forest land covered by the Act generally requires prior Central Government approval before non-forest use. The provision for areas within 100 km of an international border, LoC or LAC is not a blanket exemption: it applies only to strategic linear projects of national importance and concerning national security that satisfy the Act. Other exclusions for defence, security and notified Left-Wing Extremism-affected areas also have specific limits and conditions.
body.te: Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980కు 2023లో **Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980** అనే పేరు వచ్చింది. ఈ law వర్తించే forest landను non-forest purposeకు ఉపయోగించే ముందు సాధారణంగా Central Government prior approval అవసరం. International border, Line of Control (LoC) లేదా Line of Actual Control (LAC) నుంచి 100 km పరిధిలో ఉందనే కారణంతో ప్రతి projectకు exemption రాదు. Actలో చెప్పిన conditionsను meet చేసే national importance లేదా national securityకు సంబంధించిన strategic linear projectకే ఆ provision వర్తిస్తుంది. Defence, security, Left-Wing Extremism-affected areasకు సంబంధించిన ఇతర exclusions కూడా limited conditionsతోనే ఉంటాయి.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: After forest diversion is approved, the user agency generally pays the cost of compensatory afforestation and Net Present Value. These funds are managed for statutory purposes through the National Fund, State Funds and their CAMPA authorities under the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016. The Act replaced the earlier ad hoc arrangement created under Supreme Court directions with a permanent statutory framework.
body.te: Forest diversion approve అయిన తరువాత user agency సాధారణంగా compensatory afforestation cost, Net Present Value (NPV) చెల్లిస్తుంది. ఈ moneyని ordinary government revenueలా ఖర్చు చేయరు. Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016 ప్రకారం National Fund, State Funds మరియు వాటి CAMPA authorities statutory purposes కోసం manage చేస్తాయి. అంతకుముందు Supreme Court directions కింద ad hocగా ఉన్న CAMPA arrangementకు 2016 Act permanent statutory structure ఇచ్చింది.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: The Forest Rights Act, 2006 recognises pre-existing rights of eligible Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers; it does not create a new charity. An Individual Forest Right relates to forest land occupied for habitation or self-cultivation, subject to the Act. A Community Forest Resource right enables the Gram Sabha or community to protect, regenerate, conserve, manage and sustainably use its customary forest resource. The Gram Sabha begins the claims process. In a Critical Wildlife Habitat, rights recognition and exclusion-based conservation can create conflict and must follow the statutory safeguards.
body.te: Forest Rights Act, 2006 కొత్తగా charity ఇవ్వదు; eligible Scheduled Tribes, Other Traditional Forest Dwellersకు గతం నుంచి ఉన్న rightsను recognise చేస్తుంది. Individual Forest Right (IFR) అనేది individual లేదా household నివసిస్తూ సాగు చేస్తున్న forest landతో సంబంధం కలిగి ఉంటుంది. Community Forest Resource (CFR) right ద్వారా Gram Sabha/community తన customary forest resourceను protect, regenerate, conserve, manage చేసి sustainably use చేయగలదు. Claims processను Gram Sabha ప్రారంభిస్తుంది. Critical Wildlife Habitatలో rights recognition, exclusion-based conservation మధ్య conflict రావచ్చు; రెండూ automaticగా harmonious అని భావించకూడదు.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: Rule 5 of the Wetlands Rules, 2017 provides a Wetlands Authority for every State and Union Territory. In a State, the Minister in charge of environment, forests or wetlands is Chairperson and the Chief Secretary is Vice-Chairperson. In a Union Territory, the Administrator or Chief Secretary chairs it. This decentralised arrangement replaced the Central Wetlands Regulatory Authority under the 2010 Rules; there was no body called the National Wetland Regulatory Authority.
body.te: Wetlands Rules, 2017లో Rule 5 ప్రకారం ప్రతి State, Union Territoryకు Wetlands Authority ఉంటుంది. Stateలో environment, forests లేదా wetlands portfolio చూసే Minister Chairperson; Chief Secretary Vice-Chairperson. Union Territoryలో Administrator లేదా Chief Secretary chair చేస్తారు. ఈ decentralised system, 2010 Rulesలోని **Central Wetlands Regulatory Authority** స్థానంలో వచ్చింది. దాని పేరు ‘National Wetland Regulatory Authority’ కాదు.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: A Ramsar Site has international recognition under the Convention on Wetlands. Notification and regulation under the Wetlands Rules, 2017 are separate domestic legal processes. A wetland may have either status, both, or neither; international designation and domestic restriction are not the same.
body.te: Ramsar Site అనేది Ramsar Convention కింద international recognition. Wetlands Rules, 2017 కింద notification, regulation మాత్రం domestic legal process. అందువల్ల ఒక wetlandకు Ramsar status మాత్రమే ఉండవచ్చు, domestic notification మాత్రమే ఉండవచ్చు, రెండూ ఉండవచ్చు లేదా రెండూ లేకపోవచ్చు. International label, domestic restriction ఒకటే కాదు.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: The Wetlands Rules, 2017 are subordinate legislation under the Environment (Protection) Act. They prohibit or regulate specified activities in notified wetlands. The National Plan for Conservation of Aquatic Ecosystems is instead a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that supports lake and wetland conservation projects; it is not a statutory authority. It was formed in 2013 by merging the National Wetland Conservation Programme and National Lake Conservation Plan. MoEFCC states a funding pattern of 60:40 for States, 90:10 for North-Eastern States and 100% Central funding for Union Territories.
body.te: Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017 అనేవి Environment (Protection) Act కింద subordinate legislation. ఇవి notified wetlandsలో specified activitiesను prohibit లేదా regulate చేస్తాయి. National Plan for Conservation of Aquatic Ecosystems (NPCA) మాత్రం statutory authority కాదు; lakes, wetlands conservation projectsకు support ఇచ్చే Centrally Sponsored Scheme. National Wetland Conservation Programme, National Lake Conservation Planను merge చేసి 2013లో NPCAను ప్రారంభించారు. MoEFCC official funding statement ప్రకారం సాధారణ Statesకు Centre–State funding 60:40; North-Eastern Statesకు 90:10; Union Territoriesకు 100% Central funding.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: CRZ and Eco-Sensitive Zones both derive authority from the Environment (Protection) Act, but regulate different landscapes. The CRZ Notification, 2019 classifies coastal areas and superseded the 2011 notification. An ESZ is a site-specific regulated belt around a protected area. The two instruments are not interchangeable.
body.te: CRZ, Eco-Sensitive Zone (ESZ) రెండూ Environment (Protection) Act నుంచి authority పొందినా, regulate చేసే landscape వేరు. CRZ Notification, 2019 coastను classify చేస్తుంది; అది 2011 notificationను replace చేసింది. ESZ మాత్రం protected area చుట్టూ site-specific regulated belt. ఒకే parent Act కింద ఉన్నాయనే కారణంతో CRZ, ESZను interchange చేయకూడదు.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: Under the CRZ Notification, 2019, ecologically sensitive features fall in CRZ-I A and the inter-tidal zone in CRZ-I B. Developed urban coast is CRZ-II, while relatively undisturbed or rural coast is CRZ-III. The notified No Development Zone is 50 metres in densely populated CRZ-III A and 200 metres in CRZ-III B. Coastal and tidal-influenced waters fall in CRZ-IV. Questions should be answered using the category and threshold in the operative notification.
body.te: CRZ Notification, 2019లో ecologically sensitive features **CRZ-I A**లో, inter-tidal zone **CRZ-I B**లో ఉంటాయి. Developed urban coast **CRZ-II**; relatively undisturbed లేదా rural coast **CRZ-III**. Densely populated CRZ-III Aలో notified No Development Zone 50 metres; CRZ-III Bలో 200 metres. Coastal waters, tidal-influenced waters **CRZ-IV**లో వస్తాయి. Examలో operative notificationలోని category, thresholdనే ఉపయోగించాలి.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: When a mangrove area exceeds 1,000 square metres, the CRZ Notification, 2019 places it in CRZ-I A and also includes the specified 50-metre buffer along the mangroves in CRZ-I A. The threshold and buffer should not be mechanically applied to every smaller mangrove patch.
body.te: Mangrove area 1,000 square metresకంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉంటే, CRZ Notification, 2019 దాన్ని CRZ-I Aగా classify చేస్తుంది; mangroves వెంట specified 50-metre bufferను కూడా CRZ-I Aలో చేర్చుతుంది. ఈ area threshold, bufferను ప్రతి చిన్న mangrove patchకు mechanically apply చేయకూడదు.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: Do not confuse a statutory fund mechanism with an executive scheme. CAMPA has a statutory basis under the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016, whereas NPCA is a scheme. NGT jurisdiction is limited to enactments listed in Schedule I of the NGT Act, which does not include the Wild Life (Protection) Act. A wildlife dispute usually reaches the NGT only when it also raises a substantial environmental question under a listed law such as the Environment (Protection) Act, forest-conservation law or Biological Diversity Act.
body.te: Legal statusను schemeతో కలపకూడదు. CAMPAకు Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016 కింద statutory basis ఉంది; NPCA executive scheme. అలాగే NGT jurisdiction, NGT Act Schedule Iలో listed enactmentsకే పరిమితం. Wild Life (Protection) Act ఆ Scheduleలో లేదు. కాబట్టి wildlife disputeలో EPA, forest-conservation law, Biological Diversity Act వంటి listed lawకు సంబంధించిన substantial environmental question కూడా ఉన్నప్పుడే NGT route సాధారణంగా తెరుచుకుంటుంది.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: India's environmental institutions do not exercise the same authority. NBWL advises and reviews; NTCA oversees tiger-reserve governance; NGT adjudicates specified disputes. Policy, regulation, administration, research, monitoring and adjudication should be separated. National importance alone does not make an institution statutory; legislation must create or authorise it.
body.te: Indiaలో environmental institutions అన్నీ ఒకే authorityను exercise చేయవు. NBWL advice, review చేస్తుంది; NTCA Tiger Reserve governanceను supervise చేస్తుంది; NGT specified disputesను adjudicate చేస్తుంది. Policy, regulation, administration, research, monitoring, adjudication అనే rolesను ముందుగా వేరు చేసి చదవాలి. ఒక institution national importance కలిగి ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన statutory body కాదు; legislation దాన్ని create లేదా authorise చేసినప్పుడే statutory status వస్తుంది.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: MoEFCC is the Union Government's nodal ministry for environment, forests and wildlife. It frames central policy and supervises specialised bodies or receives their reports. It functions under the Allocation of Business Rules and is not an authority created by one environmental statute.
body.te: MoEFCC, environment, forests, wildlife విషయాల్లో Union Government nodal ministry. Central policyని frame చేసి, specialised bodiesను supervise చేస్తుంది లేదా వాటి reportsను receive చేస్తుంది. ఇది Allocation of Business Rules కింద పనిచేసే Ministry; ఒక particular environmental statute create చేసిన authority కాదు.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The National Biodiversity Authority in Chennai is a statutory body established by the Central Government under section 8 of the Biological Diversity Act. It regulates access by persons covered by section 3(2), oversees Access and Benefit-sharing arrangements and advises the Central Government.
body.te: Chennaiలోని National Biodiversity Authority (NBA), Biological Diversity Act section 8 కింద Central Government ఏర్పాటు చేసిన statutory body. Section 3(2) పరిధిలోని persons biological resources లేదా associated knowledgeను access చేసే సందర్భాలను regulate చేయడం, Access and Benefit-sharing (ABS) arrangementsను oversee చేయడం, Central Governmentకు advice ఇవ్వడం దీని ప్రధాన functions.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The National Board for Wild Life is the apex statutory advisory body under section 5A of the Wild Life (Protection) Act, with the Prime Minister as Chairperson. Its Standing Committee scrutinises proposals affecting protected areas when the applicable approval route requires it. Field authorities, not NBWL, conduct day-to-day protected-area management.
body.te: National Board for Wild Life (NBWL), WPA section 5A కింద ఉన్న apex statutory advisory body; Prime Minister దీనికి Chairperson. Protected areasను ప్రభావితం చేసే proposalsను applicable approval routeలో దాని Standing Committee scrutinise చేస్తుంది. NBWL advice, review చేస్తుంది; day-to-day protected-area management field authorities పని.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The National Tiger Conservation Authority is the statutory tiger-governance authority under section 38L of the Wild Life (Protection) Act. It oversees standards, tiger conservation plans and specified approvals for Tiger Reserves. It is distinct from WII's research role, NBWL's advisory role and wildlife funding schemes.
body.te: National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA), WPA section 38L కింద statutory tiger-governance authority. Tiger Reservesకు standards, conservation plans, approvalsను oversee చేస్తుంది. ఇది WII research role కాదు; NBWL advisory role కాదు; wildlife funding scheme కూడా కాదు.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The Wildlife Crime Control Bureau coordinates intelligence and enforcement against organised wildlife crime. Section 38Y of the Wild Life (Protection) Act establishes this statutory Bureau; section 38XA is a savings provision, not its constituting section.
body.te: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB), organised wildlife crimeపై intelligence, enforcement coordination చేస్తుంది. WPA section 38Y ఈ statutory Bureauను create చేసింది. Section 38XA savings provision మాత్రమే; WCCB constituting section కాదు.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The Central Zoo Authority recognises and regulates Indian zoos and sets zoo-management standards. Its work also includes ex-situ conservation, conservation breeding and Species Survival Plans. Section 38A, inserted by the 1991 amendment to the Wild Life (Protection) Act, gives it statutory status.
body.te: Central Zoo Authority (CZA), Indian zoosను recognise, regulate చేసి zoo-management standardsను set చేస్తుంది. Ex-situ conservation, conservation breeding, Species Survival Plans కూడా దీని workలో భాగం. 1991 Amendmentతో వచ్చిన WPA section 38A, CZAకు statutory basis ఇచ్చింది.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The Wildlife Institute of India in Dehradun is a national institution for wildlife research and training. It develops population-estimation and monitoring methods, supports management planning and maintains the National Wildlife Database. Established in 1982 and autonomous from April 1986, it is an autonomous MoEFCC institution rather than a statutory body.
body.te: Wildlife Institute of India (WII), Dehradun wildlife research, trainingకు national institution. Population-estimation, monitoring methodsను develop చేసి management planningకు support ఇస్తుంది; National Wildlife Databaseను maintain చేస్తుంది. 1982లో establish అయి April 1986 నుంచి autonomousగా పనిచేస్తున్న WII, MoEFCC autonomous institution; statutory body కాదు.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The Botanical Survey of India and Zoological Survey of India, both headquartered in Kolkata, survey, explore, classify and inventory plants and animals respectively. Their taxonomic work documents known diversity and helps identify previously unrecorded species. Both are non-statutory subordinate offices of MoEFCC.
body.te: Kolkataలోని Botanical Survey of India (BSI), Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) వరుసగా plants, animalsపై survey, exploration, classification, inventory చేస్తాయి. Taxonomic work ద్వారా known diversityను document చేసి, unrecorded speciesను identify చేయడంలో సహాయపడతాయి. రెండూ MoEFCC subordinate offices; statutory authorities కావు.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The Forest Survey of India in Dehradun monitors forest and tree resources through satellite forest-cover mapping, the National Forest Inventory and forest-fire alerts. Its flagship publication is the biennial India State of Forest Report. FSI was created on 1 June 1981 as successor to the Pre-Investment Survey of Forest Resources begun in 1965. It is a non-statutory subordinate office of MoEFCC.
body.te: Forest Survey of India (FSI), Dehradun satellite forest-cover mapping, National Forest Inventory, forest-fire alerts ద్వారా forest and tree resourcesను monitor చేస్తుంది. Biennial India State of Forest Report దీని flagship publication. 1965లోని Pre-Investment Survey of Forest Resourcesకు successorగా 1 June 1981న FSI ఏర్పడింది. ఇది non-statutory MoEFCC subordinate office.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: ICAR–National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources in New Delhi is India's nodal institution for plant genetic resources. It collects, quarantines, characterises and evaluates germplasm and conserves it ex situ in the National Genebank. India's first National Genebank was established there in 1996; official ICAR information reported 0.47 million accessions and 12 regional stations as of 15 January 2025. Such operational totals are date-specific.
body.te: ICAR–National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR), New Delhi plant genetic resourcesకు nodal institution. Germplasm collection, quarantine, characterisation, evaluation చేసి, National Genebankలో ex-situగా conserve చేస్తుంది. India's first National Genebankను 1996లో ఇక్కడ establish చేశారు. ICAR official information ప్రకారం 15 January 2025 నాటికి 0.47 million accessions, 12 regional stations ఉన్నాయి. ఇవి date-specific operational figures.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: SACON near Anaikatty, Coimbatore specialises in ornithology and natural history. It supports research on birds and habitats, ornithological information and postgraduate and doctoral training. SACON is an autonomous MoEFCC institution, not a statutory authority. National roles do not by themselves make FSI, NBPGR or SACON statutory.
body.te: Anaikatty, Coimbatore సమీపంలోని SACON, ornithology, natural historyలో specialise చేస్తుంది. Birds, habitatsపై research, national ornithological information, postgraduate–doctoral trainingకు support ఇస్తుంది. SACON autonomous MoEFCC institution; statutory authority కాదు. FSI, NBPGR, SACONకు national roles ఉన్నా express legislative basis లేకపోవడంతో non-statutoryగానే ఉంటాయి.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The National Green Tribunal, established in 2010, is a specialised adjudicatory forum. It hears substantial environmental questions arising under the seven enactments listed in Schedule I of the NGT Act; it does not make policy or manage sites. Because the Wild Life (Protection) Act is not in Schedule I, a wildlife issue alone does not automatically confer jurisdiction; there must also be an overlapping issue under a listed enactment.
body.te: National Green Tribunal (NGT), 2010లో ఏర్పడిన specialised adjudicatory forum. NGT Act Schedule Iలోని seven enactments కింద వచ్చే substantial environmental questionsను hear చేస్తుంది. Policy తయారు చేయడం లేదా field management దీని పని కాదు. WPA Schedule Iలో లేకపోవడంతో wildlife issue మాత్రమే ఉన్న dispute automaticగా NGT jurisdictionలోకి రాదు; listed law కింద overlapping issue కూడా అవసరం.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: National and State CAMPA bodies manage funds collected from forest diversion for compensatory afforestation and related restoration. The Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016 gave statutory form to the earlier ad hoc arrangement created under Supreme Court directions.

body.en: Protected-area totals must always carry a date. A PIB release of 3 March 2025 reproduced the National Wildlife Database snapshot of 27 November 2023: 106 National Parks, 573 Wildlife Sanctuaries, 115 Conservation Reserves and 220 Community Reserves, totalling 1,014 protected areas and 5.32% of India's geographical area. These figures are historical, not current; Tiger Reserve, Biosphere Reserve and Ramsar totals also change. This dated national share is not the same measure as the global 30×30 target.

body.en: India's biodiversity-planning sequence is: the 1999 macro-level strategy, Cabinet-approved NBAP 2008, the 2014 Addendum and NBSAP 2024–2030. India did not replace NBAP 2008 when the CBD adopted 20 Aichi Targets. The 2014 Addendum collectively incorporated those targets into 12 Indian National Biodiversity Targets; the mapping was not one-to-one.
body.te: India biodiversity-planning sequence: 1999 macro-level strategy → Cabinet-approved NBAP 2008 → 2014 Addendum → NBSAP 2024–2030. CBDలో 20 Aichi Targets వచ్చిన తరువాత India NBAP 2008ను replace చేయలేదు. 2014 Addendum, 12 Indian National Biodiversity Targetsలో మొత్తం 20 Aichi Targetsను collectively absorb చేసింది; mapping one-to-one కాదు.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: India's biodiversity-planning sequence is: the 1999 macro-level strategy, Cabinet-approved NBAP 2008, the 2014 Addendum and NBSAP 2024–2030. India did not replace NBAP 2008 when the CBD adopted 20 Aichi Targets. The 2014 Addendum collectively incorporated those targets into 12 Indian National Biodiversity Targets; the mapping was not one-to-one.
body.te: India biodiversity-planning sequence: 1999 macro-level strategy → Cabinet-approved NBAP 2008 → 2014 Addendum → NBSAP 2024–2030. CBDలో 20 Aichi Targets వచ్చిన తరువాత India NBAP 2008ను replace చేయలేదు. 2014 Addendum, 12 Indian National Biodiversity Targetsలో మొత్తం 20 Aichi Targetsను collectively absorb చేసింది; mapping one-to-one కాదు.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: India released NBSAP 2024–2030 at CBD COP16 in Cali on 30 October 2024. Its 23 National Biodiversity Targets align with the 23 targets of the KMGBF and use 2030 and 2050 horizons. India treats Target 3 as a collective global goal rather than an identical national quota; qualifying OECMs may contribute without becoming protected areas under the Wild Life (Protection) Act.
body.te: India, NBSAP 2024–2030ను 30 October 2024న Cali CBD COP16లో release చేసింది. ఇందులో 23 National Biodiversity Targets, KMGBFలోని 23 targetsతో align అవుతూ 2030, 2050 horizonsను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి. India, Target 3ను identical national quotaగా కాక collective global goalగా చూస్తుంది; qualifying OECMs, WPA protected areasగా మారకుండానే contribute చేయవచ్చు.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: The Seventh National Report should be read as a dated Government self-assessment, not an independent evaluation. MoEFCC submitted it to the CBD on 26 February 2026. It uses 142 national indicators mapped to 23 National Biodiversity Targets and draws on coordinated inputs from ministries, States, statutory authorities and research institutions. SBBs support State-level implementation, while BMCs and People's Biodiversity Registers provide local evidence.
body.te: Seventh National Reportను dated Government self-assessmentగా చదవాలి; independent evaluationగా కాదు. MoEFCC ఈ reportను 26 February 2026న CBDకు submit చేసింది. ఇందులో 23 National Biodiversity Targetsకు map చేసిన 142 national indicators ఉన్నాయి; Ministries, States, statutory authorities, research institutions ఇచ్చిన coordinated inputsను ఉపయోగించింది. SBBs State-level implementationకు support చేస్తాయి; BMCs, People's Biodiversity Registers ద్వారా local evidenceను అందిస్తాయి.

body.en: Ramsar COP15 was held at Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe, from 23 to 31 July 2025. It adopted the Fifth Strategic Plan for 2025–2034. The Standing Committee elected at COP15 serves the 2025–2028 triennium, and Resolution XV.10 sets the scientific and technical work framework for 2025–2028. These are international governance facts and do not replace regulation under India's Wetlands Rules.
body.te: Ramsar COP15, 23–31 July 2025 మధ్య Victoria Falls, Zimbabweలో జరిగింది. అది Fifth Strategic Plan 2025–2034ను adopt చేసింది. Current Standing Committee term 2025–2028; Resolution XV.10 scientific, technical workకు 2025–2028 prioritiesను ఇచ్చింది. ఇవి international governance facts మాత్రమే; Ramsar designationను Indian Wetlands Rules regulationతో merge చేయవు.

body.en: The WPA is India's principal wildlife-protection law. It prohibits or regulates hunting and trade in wild animals, specified plants and their derivatives, and it authorises governments to notify protected areas. The original six schedules were reorganised by the 2022 Amendment. In each state, the Chief Wildlife Warden is the principal officer responsible for implementing the Act.
body.te: WPA అనేది Indiaలో ప్రధాన wildlife-protection law. Wild animals, specified plants, వాటి derivativesకు సంబంధించిన hunting, tradeను ఇది prohibit లేదా regulate చేస్తుంది. Protected areasను notify చేసే authorityని కూడా governmentsకు ఇస్తుంది. మొదట ఉన్న six Schedulesను 2022 Amendment reorganise చేసింది. State levelలో Act implementationకు Chief Wildlife Warden ప్రధాన officer.

title.en: Forests, rights, wetlands and coastal regulation
title.te: అడవులు, హక్కులు, చిత్తడి నేలలు మరియు తీర నియంత్రణ

body.en: The Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980 was renamed the Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980 in 2023. Forest land covered by the Act generally requires prior Central Government approval before non-forest use. The provision for areas within 100 km of an international border, LoC or LAC is not a blanket exemption: it applies only to strategic linear projects of national importance and concerning national security that satisfy the Act. Other exclusions for defence, security and notified Left-Wing Extremism-affected areas also have specific limits and conditions.
body.te: Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980కు 2023లో **Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980** అనే పేరు వచ్చింది. ఈ law వర్తించే forest landను non-forest purposeకు ఉపయోగించే ముందు సాధారణంగా Central Government prior approval అవసరం. International border, Line of Control (LoC) లేదా Line of Actual Control (LAC) నుంచి 100 km పరిధిలో ఉందనే కారణంతో ప్రతి projectకు exemption రాదు. Actలో చెప్పిన conditionsను meet చేసే national importance లేదా national securityకు సంబంధించిన strategic linear projectకే ఆ provision వర్తిస్తుంది. Defence, security, Left-Wing Extremism-affected areasకు సంబంధించిన ఇతర exclusions కూడా limited conditionsతోనే ఉంటాయి.

title.te: జాతీయ సంస్థలు మరియు జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రణాళిక

body.en: India's environmental institutions do not exercise the same authority. NBWL advises and reviews; NTCA oversees tiger-reserve governance; NGT adjudicates specified disputes. Policy, regulation, administration, research, monitoring and adjudication should be separated. National importance alone does not make an institution statutory; legislation must create or authorise it.
body.te: Indiaలో environmental institutions అన్నీ ఒకే authorityను exercise చేయవు. NBWL advice, review చేస్తుంది; NTCA Tiger Reserve governanceను supervise చేస్తుంది; NGT specified disputesను adjudicate చేస్తుంది. Policy, regulation, administration, research, monitoring, adjudication అనే rolesను ముందుగా వేరు చేసి చదవాలి. ఒక institution national importance కలిగి ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన statutory body కాదు; legislation దాన్ని create లేదా authorise చేసినప్పుడే statutory status వస్తుంది.

title.en: Reading conservation status and flagship programmes
title.te: Conservation status, flagship programmesను ఎలా అర్థం చేసుకోవాలి?

paragraphs.en: Wildlife questions often place IUCN, CITES and India's Wild Life (Protection) Act side by side, although they answer different questions. The IUCN Red List estimates a species' global extinction risk. CITES regulates international trade in listed species, while the WPA supplies legal protection within India. A species can therefore carry an IUCN category, a CITES Appendix listing and a WPA Schedule listing at the same time; one label cannot substitute for another.
paragraphs.te: Wildlife conservationలో IUCN Red List, CITES, Wild Life (Protection) Act (WPA) తరచుగా కలిసి కనిపిస్తాయి; కానీ ఇవి అడిగే questions వేర్వేరు. IUCN ఒక speciesకు global extinction risk ఎంత ఉందో assess చేస్తుంది. CITES listed speciesలో international tradeను regulate చేస్తుంది. WPA మాత్రం Indiaలో legal protection ఇస్తుంది. అందువల్ల ఒకే speciesకు IUCN category, CITES Appendix, WPA Schedule మూడు ఉండవచ్చు; ఒకదాని labelను మరొకదానికి బదులుగా వాడకూడదు.

paragraphs.en: For assessed taxa, the familiar risk sequence is LC → NT → VU → EN → CR, followed by EW and EX. CR is the highest-risk category for a taxon that still survives in the wild. EW means that it remains only in captivity or cultivation, or as a naturalised population outside its former native range. EX is assigned only when there is no reasonable doubt that the last individual has died.
paragraphs.te: Assess చేసిన taxaలో risk క్రమం LC → NT → VU → EN → CR; తరువాత EW, EX వస్తాయి. Wildలో ఇంకా జీవిస్తున్న taxonకు అత్యధిక extinction riskను Critically Endangered (CR) సూచిస్తుంది. Extinct in the Wild (EW) అంటే captivity లేదా cultivationలో మాత్రమే, లేదా original native range బయట naturalised populationగా మాత్రమే మిగిలి ఉండటం. చివరి individual కూడా చనిపోయిందనే విషయంలో reasonable doubt లేనప్పుడే Extinct (EX)గా classify చేస్తారు.

paragraphs.en: Only VU, EN and CR together form the IUCN 'threatened' categories. Data Deficient is not a reassuring category: it says that the evidence is insufficient to assess extinction risk. Not Evaluated means that the taxon has not yet passed through an IUCN assessment. Thus DD means 'not enough data', whereas NE means 'not yet assessed'.
paragraphs.te: IUCNలో Vulnerable (VU), Endangered (EN), Critically Endangered (CR)ను మాత్రమే కలిపి threatened categories అంటారు. Data Deficient (DD) అంటే risk తక్కువ అని కాదు; extinction riskను assess చేయడానికి evidence సరిపోలేదని అర్థం. Not Evaluated (NE) అంటే ఆ taxonకు ఇంకా IUCN assessment జరగలేదు. సులభంగా గుర్తుంచుకోవాలంటే—DDలో data సరిపోదు; NEలో assessment ఇంకా జరగలేదు.

paragraphs.en: IUCN applies five criterion sets rather than one universal test. A measures population reduction; B examines geographic range; C concerns a small and declining population; D identifies a very small or restricted population; and E uses a quantitative extinction-probability analysis. Meeting any one applicable criterion can justify a category. Under Criterion A, CR–EN–VU thresholds are 90–70–50% for A1 and 80–50–30% for A2–A4, measured across ten years or three generations, whichever is longer. Criterion D can identify danger from extreme smallness even without a demonstrated current decline.
paragraphs.te: IUCN riskను ఒకే formulaతో నిర్ణయించదు; A నుంచి E వరకు five criterion setsను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. Criterion A population reductionను, B geographic rangeను, C small and declining populationను, D very small లేదా restricted populationను, E quantitative extinction probabilityను పరిశీలిస్తాయి. వర్తించే criteriaలో ఒక్కటి satisfy అయినా category నిర్ణయించవచ్చు. Criterion Aలో CR–EN–VU thresholds A1కు 90–70–50%; A2–A4కు 80–50–30%. Assessment period పది years లేదా మూడు generations—ఏది ఎక్కువైతే అది. Current decline కనిపించకపోయినా population అత్యంత చిన్నదైతే Criterion D riskను గుర్తించగలదు.

paragraphs.en: Project, Recovery Programme and Action Plan describe different administrative instruments. A Project is generally a named and funded implementation mechanism. Under Integrated Development of Wildlife Habitats, the species-recovery component acts as an umbrella that supports several species-specific efforts. An Action Plan is ordinarily a time-bound strategy setting objectives and measures. A State initiative remains a State initiative, and an international partnership does not become an Indian field scheme or statutory authority merely because India participates in it.
paragraphs.te: Project, Recovery Programme, Action Plan ఒకే అర్థం ఇచ్చే terms కావు. సాధారణంగా specific name, funding, implementation mechanism ఉన్నదాన్ని Project అంటారు. Integrated Development of Wildlife Habitats (IDWH) కింద species-recovery component అనేక species-specific effortsకు umbrella programmeగా పనిచేస్తుంది. Action Plan అనేది నిర్ణీత కాలానికి objectives, measures చెప్పే strategy document. State government ప్రారంభించిన initiativeను Central projectగా, India పాల్గొనే international partnershipను Indian field scheme లేదా statutory authorityగా భావించకూడదు.

paragraphs.en: India launched Project Tiger in 1973 to conserve both tigers and their habitats. Tiger-reserve conservation is now overseen by the National Tiger Conservation Authority, which has statutory status. Because new reserves may be notified and existing boundaries may change, a national total has value only when it is attached to the date of the relevant NTCA list.
paragraphs.te: Tigersతో పాటు వాటి habitatsను conserve చేయడానికి India 1973లో Project Tigerను ప్రారంభించింది. ఇప్పుడు Tiger Reserves conservationను statutory body అయిన National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) oversee చేస్తుంది. కొత్త reserves notify కావచ్చు; existing boundaries మారవచ్చు. కాబట్టి “మొత్తం Tiger Reserves ఎన్ని?” అనే సంఖ్యను relevant NTCA list dateతో కలిపి మాత్రమే చదవాలి.

paragraphs.en: The fifth All India Tiger Estimation was completed in 2022. Government communication commonly cites about 3,682 tigers, while an NTCA FAQ gives 3,652 with a range of 3,167–3,925; each figure must remain tied to its source. The sixth cycle began in 2026, but an interim or reserve-level result cannot stand in for its final national estimate. AITE combines field signs and habitat surveys with camera traps and genetic evidence. M-STrIPES serves a different operational purpose: spatial monitoring and patrol management.
paragraphs.te: Fifth All India Tiger Estimation (AITE) 2022లో పూర్తైంది. Government communicationలో సుమారు 3,682 అనే figure ఎక్కువగా కనిపిస్తుంది; NTCA FAQలో estimate 3,652గా, range 3,167–3,925గా ఉంది. ఈ రెండు figuresను కలపకుండా, respective sourceతోనే quote చేయాలి. Sixth AITE cycle 2026లో మొదలైంది; interim లేదా reserve-level resultను final national estimateగా చెప్పకూడదు. AITEలో field signs, habitat surveys, camera traps, genetic evidenceను combine చేస్తారు. M-STrIPES పని వేరు—spatial monitoring, patrol managementకు support ఇవ్వడం.

paragraphs.en: Calling the tiger an apex predator, keystone species, umbrella species and flagship species does not repeat the same idea four times. Its place at the top of the food web explains the apex-predator role; its strong ecological influence supports the keystone label. Conserving its extensive connected habitat protects many accompanying species, making it an umbrella species. Its public and cultural appeal allows it to mobilise support as a flagship species.
paragraphs.te: Tigerను apex predator, keystone species, umbrella species, flagship species అని పిలిచినా నాలుగు terms ఒకే విషయం చెప్పవు. Food webలో top predatorగా ఉండటం apex role. Ecosystemపై proportionately strong influence చూపడం keystone role. Tigerకు అవసరమైన large, connected habitatను protect చేస్తే అక్కడి అనేక speciesకూ protection లభిస్తుంది—అందుకే umbrella species. Public appeal, cultural value ద్వారా conservation supportను mobilise చేయగలదు—అందుకే flagship species.

paragraphs.en: A tiger leaving a reserve does not automatically prove that the reserve has crossed its carrying capacity. Dispersal may reflect territorial displacement, local density, prey or habitat beyond the reserve, and the condition of corridors. Successful recovery must therefore protect connected landscapes and movement routes, not merely raise the number inside reserve boundaries, while also reducing conflict with people.
paragraphs.te: ఒక tiger reserve బయటకు వెళ్లిందంటే reserve carrying capacity తప్పకుండా exceed అయిందని చెప్పలేం. Territorial displacement, local population density, reserve బయట prey–habitat availability, wildlife corridors condition—all ఇవి dispersalను ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి. అందువల్ల tiger recoveryను reserve లోపలి headcountతో మాత్రమే కొలవకూడదు; connected landscapes, movement routesను protect చేస్తూ human conflictను కూడా తగ్గించాలి.

paragraphs.en: Project Elephant began in 1992 as a Central conservation project. It seeks to conserve wild Asian elephants, secure habitats and movement corridors, manage human–elephant conflict and improve the welfare of captive elephants. Counting elephants is therefore only one input to a programme whose real scope includes habitat, connectivity, conflict and welfare.
paragraphs.te: Project Elephantను Central conservation projectగా 1992లో ప్రారంభించారు. Wild Asian elephantsను conserve చేయడం, habitats–movement corridorsను secure చేయడం, human–elephant conflictను manage చేయడం, captive elephants welfareను improve చేయడం దీని objectives. కాబట్టి ఇది elephant counting exercise మాత్రమే కాదు; habitat, connectivity, conflict, welfare అన్నింటినీ కలిపిన programme.

paragraphs.en: The 2021–25 Synchronous All India Elephant Estimation reported about 22,446 wild elephants, with an estimated range of 18,255–26,645. It was the first nationally synchronised exercise to identify individuals genetically from dung samples. That method is not directly continuous with older direct-count estimates. Because 27,312 and 29,964 are both cited as 2017 baselines, different comparisons yield different headline percentages. A responsible comparison must name the baseline and explain the methodological break; reserve, corridor and global-share figures must likewise carry dates.
paragraphs.te: 2021–25 Synchronous All India Elephant Estimation (SAIEE) ప్రకారం wild elephants estimate సుమారు 22,446; estimated range 18,255–26,645. Dung samples నుంచి DNAతో individual elephantsను identify చేసిన first nationally synchronised assessment ఇది. Older direct countsతో ఈ methodకు direct continuity లేదు. 2017 baselineగా 27,312, 29,964 అనే రెండు totals కనిపిస్తాయి; ఏ baseline తీసుకుంటే ఆ percentage వస్తుంది. అందుకే decline percentage చెప్పేటప్పుడు comparatorను name చేసి, method changeను explain చేయాలి. Elephant Reserves, corridors, India global share వంటి figuresకూ date అవసరం.

paragraphs.en: Habitat fragmentation often forces elephants following traditional routes to cross farms and settlements, increasing human–elephant conflict. Protecting functional corridors is therefore not an optional addition but a central part of elephant conservation. Gaj Yatra, associated with Project Elephant, is a public-awareness campaign intended to build support for safeguarding those corridors.
paragraphs.te: Habitat fragmentation వల్ల elephants తమ traditional movement routesలో farms, settlementsను cross చేయాల్సి వస్తుంది; ఇక్కడే human–elephant conflict పెరుగుతుంది. అందువల్ల functional elephant corridorsను protect చేయడం supplementary activity కాదు—conservationలో central requirement. Project Elephantతో associated అయిన Gaj Yatra ఒక public-awareness campaign; corridors protectionకు public support పెంచడం దీని purpose.

title.en: From population monitoring to species recovery
title.te: Population monitoring నుంచి species recovery వరకు

paragraphs.en: Wildlife monitoring is not simply a headcount. A census attempts a direct count where that is practicable; an estimate uses sampled evidence to infer the population. In AITE, WII and NTCA integrate field signs, camera-trap records, spatial models and habitat information. A wildlife number becomes meaningful only when its survey year and method are stated with it.
paragraphs.te: Wildlife monitoring అంటే headcount మాత్రమే కాదు. ప్రతి individualను directగా count చేయడం feasible అయినప్పుడు census చేస్తారు; sample evidence నుంచి total populationను infer చేస్తే అది estimate. AITEలో Wildlife Institute of India (WII), NTCA కలిసి field signs, camera-trap records, spatial models, habitat informationను integrate చేస్తాయి. కాబట్టి wildlife figureను survey year, method లేకుండా చదవడం సరైంది కాదు.

paragraphs.en: Gujarat's sixteenth Asiatic-lion estimation recorded 891 lions in 2025, compared with 674 in 2020, and many were outside protected-area boundaries. Growth has not removed the systemic risk: the world's only wild Asiatic-lion population remains concentrated in the Greater Gir landscape. Project Lion was announced on 15 August 2020 and received approval for a ten-year financial outlay on 1 March 2025. It is distinct from the Supreme Court's 2013 Kuno translocation direction, habitat expansion into Barda, and Andhra Pradesh's unrelated Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N.
paragraphs.te: Gujarat 16th Asiatic Lion Estimationలో 2025కు 891 lions నమోదయ్యాయి; 2020లో 674. వీటిలో చాలావరకు protected-area boundaries బయట ఉన్నాయి. Population పెరిగినా systemic risk తొలగలేదు, ఎందుకంటే ప్రపంచంలోని only wild Asiatic-lion population Greater Gir landscapeలోనే concentratedగా ఉంది. Project Lionను 15 August 2020న announce చేశారు; ten-year financial outlayకు 1 March 2025న approval వచ్చింది. ఇది Supreme Court 2013 Kuno translocation direction, Barda habitat expansion, Andhra Pradesh Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N. నుంచి పూర్తిగా వేరు. H.A.N.U.M.A.N. 3 March 2026న ప్రారంభమైన wildlife protection–human conflict State programme; lion project కాదు.

paragraphs.en: India declared the cheetah extinct within the country in 1952, so bringing African cheetahs is a reintroduction, not reinforcement of an existing wild population. Animals have come from Namibia, South Africa and Botswana. Using Kuno and Gandhi Sagar reduces single-site dependence and connects cheetah recovery with grassland conservation. Totals change quickly through births, deaths and transfers: official reporting moved from 57 on 10 May 2026 to about 53 on 13 May after four cub deaths. Every total therefore needs a date and, when relevant, a site-wise break-up.
paragraphs.te: Indiaలో cheetah extinct అయిందని 1952లో declare చేశారు. Existing wild population లేకపోవడంతో African cheetahsను తీసుకురావడం reintroduction; reinforcement కాదు. Animals Namibia, South Africa, Botswana నుంచి వచ్చాయి. Kunoతో పాటు Gandhi Sagarను use చేయడం single-site dependenceను తగ్గించి cheetah recoveryను grassland conservationతో link చేస్తుంది. Births, deaths, transfers వల్ల total వేగంగా మారుతుంది: official reportingలో 10 May 2026న 57 ఉండగా, four cub deaths తరువాత 13 Mayకు సుమారు 53 అయింది. అందుకే ప్రతి totalకు date, అవసరమైతే site-wise distribution ఇవ్వాలి.

paragraphs.en: The Snow Leopard Population Assessment in India, released on 30 January 2024 from 2019–23 fieldwork, estimated 718 snow leopards; Ladakh contributed the largest count, 477. Camera-trap grids and genetic analysis of scat suit a secretive, wide-ranging high-altitude cat. Project Snow Leopard is India's programme, whereas GSLEP is a separate partnership of twelve range countries. Retaliatory killing after livestock loss, poaching, loss of wild prey and competition with livestock remain major threats.
paragraphs.te: 2019–23 fieldwork ఆధారంగా రూపొందిన Snow Leopard Population Assessment in India (SPAI)ను 30 January 2024న release చేశారు. India estimate 718; highest share Ladakhలో 477. Elusiveగా ఉండి wide high-altitude rangeలో తిరిగే ఈ catకు camera-trap grids, scat genetic analysis suitable methods. Project Snow Leopard Indian programme; Global Snow Leopard and Ecosystem Protection Program (GSLEP) మాత్రం twelve-country partnership. Livestock loss తరువాత retaliatory killing, poaching, wild prey depletion, livestock competition ప్రధాన threats.

paragraphs.en: Project Dolphin covers dolphins of rivers, estuaries and the sea, but the figure of about 6,327 has a narrower meaning. It comes from India's first comprehensive river-dolphin assessment, reported in 2025 for the Ganga, Brahmaputra and Indus systems; it is not a total for every dolphin covered by the project. A second range-wide assessment of riverine and estuarine dolphins began in January 2026 to create a comparable time series. Survey and year must accompany every figure.
paragraphs.te: Project Dolphin scopeలో river, estuary, marine dolphins ఉన్నాయి. కానీ సుమారు 6,327 అనే figureకు narrower meaning ఉంది: ఇది 2025లో report చేసిన first comprehensive river-dolphin assessmentలో Ganga, Brahmaputra, Indus systemsకు సంబంధించిన total మాత్రమే. Projectలోని అన్ని freshwater, estuarine, marine dolphins total కాదు. Comparable time series నిర్మించడానికి second range-wide riverine–estuarine assessment January 2026లో ప్రారంభమైంది. ప్రతి figureతో survey, year తప్పనిసరిగా చెప్పాలి.

paragraphs.en: The gharial is a Critically Endangered, predominantly fish-eating crocodilian. Much of the surviving population is concentrated in the Chambal, and the species needs free-flowing rivers with suitable sandbanks. Dams and sand mining also damage river-dolphin habitat. Releasing head-started gharials into Chambal's existing population is reinforcement; releasing them where they had disappeared locally, such as the Beas or the Ganga at Murshidabad, is reintroduction.
paragraphs.te: Gharial ప్రధానంగా fish-eating crocodilian; IUCN status Critically Endangered. Surviving populationలో పెద్ద భాగం Chambalలో concentratedగా ఉంది. దీనికి free-flowing rivers, suitable sandbanks అవసరం. Dams, sand mining వల్ల river dolphins habitatకూ damage జరుగుతుంది. Head-started gharialsను existing Chambal populationలో release చేస్తే reinforcement. Species locally disappeared అయిన Beas లేదా Murshidabad వద్ద Gangaలో release చేస్తే reintroduction.

paragraphs.en: Project Crocodile began in 1975 through cooperation among the Government of India, UNDP and FAO. It covered the gharial, mugger and saltwater crocodile, globally classified as CR, VU and LC respectively. Eggs were collected and incubated; young crocodilians were reared through their most vulnerable stage and then released, with support also going to breeding centres and protected areas. More than 7,000 releases had been reported by the fiftieth anniversary in 2025. Recovery was uneven: mugger and saltwater crocodile populations improved markedly, while the gharial remained CR.
paragraphs.te: Project Crocodileను 1975లో Government of India, UNDP, FAO cooperationతో ప్రారంభించారు. ఇందులో gharial, mugger, saltwater crocodile ఉన్నాయి; వాటి global IUCN categories వరుసగా CR, VU, LC. Eggs collect చేసి incubate చేయడం, young crocodiliansను vulnerable early stage దాటే వరకు rear చేసి suitable habitatలో release చేయడం programme method. Breeding centres, protected areasకూ support ఇచ్చారు. 2025లో 50th anniversary నాటికి 7,000కుపైగా releases report అయ్యాయి. Recovery equalగా లేదు: mugger, saltwater crocodile populations బాగా improve కాగా gharial ఇంకా CRలోనే ఉంది.

paragraphs.en: White-rumped, long-billed and slender-billed vultures fell by more than 95%, chiefly after feeding on livestock carcasses contaminated with veterinary diclofenac; habitat loss was not the principal driver of this crash. India banned veterinary diclofenac in 2006. The National Vulture Action Plan covered 2020–25 and cannot automatically be called current after that period. A captive-bred release is reinforcement where a wild colony remains and reintroduction where the species has vanished locally. Because vultures remove carcasses, their decline can favour feral dogs and raise disease and rabies risks.
paragraphs.te: White-rumped, long-billed, slender-billed vultures 95%కుపైగా decline కావడానికి main cause habitat loss కాదు. Veterinary diclofenac ఉన్న livestock carcasses తినడం వల్ల toxic effect వచ్చింది. India veterinary diclofenac useను 2006లో ban చేసింది. National Vulture Action Plan period 2020–25; successor verify చేయకుండా 2026లో current plan అని చెప్పకూడదు. Wild colony ఇంకా ఉన్న చోట captive-bred birds release చేస్తే reinforcement; locally vanished చోట release చేస్తే reintroduction. Vultures carcasses తొలగిస్తాయి; అవి తగ్గితే feral dogs పెరిగి disease, rabies risk పెరగవచ్చు.

paragraphs.en: The Great Indian Bustard is Critically Endangered and now survives chiefly in the Thar. Collision with overhead high-tension power lines is a major documented recent mortality pressure, creating a difficult overlap between renewable-energy infrastructure and bustard habitat. Releasing captive-bred birds into the surviving Thar population would be reinforcement; restoring the species to Madhya Pradesh after local extinction would be reintroduction.
